steps.code:
liked_ids = {song['song_id'] for song in liked}
# Also include page 1 (empty) but we already have all.
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
print("Current song id:", current['song_id'])
# Loop until we find a liked song
while current['song_id'] not in liked_ids:
    print("Song", current['song_id'], "not liked, going next")
    resp = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("next_song response:", resp)
    # After next, get current song again
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Now current song id:", current['song_id'])
# Found liked song
print("Found liked song:", current['song_id'], current['title'])
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=current['song_id'])
